svg.title: TokenDaily — Windows 与 macOS 的个人 AI 用量助手
svg.desc: 紧凑品牌横幅：左侧为 TokenDaily 渐变 Logo、平等并列的 Windows 和 macOS 标识与产品介绍，右侧为悬浮面板结构示意。今日 Token、API 费用估算、排名、额度、积分与日历均为合成示例，不代表真实账户或账单。平台安装与验证状态见 README 快速开始。

svg.title: TokenDaily — complete gradient logo
svg.desc: TokenDaily icon and wordmark reconstructed as true vector paths with smooth teal-to-mint gradients. The approved ring, detached dot and rounded square are retained. The letters are outlined from the supplied artwork; no font or bitmap is embedded.

svg.title: TokenDaily gradient logo
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the supplied TokenDaily icon. Teal-to-mint continuous gradients; circular ring with an upper-right separate dot and a central rounded square. Transparent background. No embedded bitmap.
